label: PF Backlog 594
title: EDP-13: Local filesystem ObjectStore adapter (root containment, symlink defense, atomic writes, checksum, size limits)
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.

brief.problem: No ObjectStore adapter exists for local development/self-hosted deployments behind the provider-neutral interface.
brief.what_adds: Go localfs adapter with containment, symlink defense, atomic writes, checksums, size limits.
brief.why: Needed for dev/self-hosted parity and as reference implementation for the interface.

objective: Provide a Go local-filesystem ObjectStore adapter with root containment, symlink defense, atomic writes, checksum verification, and size limits, passing the shared conformance suite.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter passes all BI-PF-1299 conformance tests
Symlink escape and path traversal attempts denied
Writes are atomic (no partial object visible on crash simulation)
Checksum mismatch on read detected; size limit enforced with clear error
approach: Implement interface, register in adapter factory, write security-focused tests (traversal, symlink, TOCTOU), run shared conformance harness, wire config root/limits.
risks: Atomic rename not atomic across devices
Size-limit enforcement race on concurrent writes
rollback: Adapter is additive and opt-in via config; remove registration to revert without code rollback.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Implement a Go local-filesystem ObjectStore adapter satisfying the provider-neutral interfaces from BI-PF-1299, validated against the shared conformance harness: root containment via path canonicalization, symlink defense (EvalSymlinks + root check), atomic writes (temp file + rename), checksum (sha256) verification, and configurable size limits. Use existing Python adapter modules (generator/intake/test/vendor_adapters.py) only as naming/behavioral pattern references.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-1299 (state: interfaces + conformance harness merged)
REQUIRES BI-PF-1306 (state: any - shared adapter wiring/conventions established)
RELATED BI-PF-1303 (attestation may gate which adapter is allowed per cell)
conflict_findings: Low conflict: adapter is isolated behind interface; only registration/factory wiring shared with BI-PF-1306
duplication_findings: No existing localfs ObjectStore implementation found
Python adapter components are structural precedents, not reusable under L1=Go
Conformance harness from BI-PF-1299 must be reused, not re-implemented
analysis.rationale: Local filesystem adapter is a natural first concrete implementation behind the new provider-neutral interface and is fully testable via the existing conformance harness.
assumptions: BI-PF-1299 harness runs against in-process adapters
Single-root deployment model (root dir from config)
risks: Atomic rename not atomic across devices
Size-limit enforcement race on concurrent writes
missing_info: Default root directory and config key
Whether directory listing/delete semantics are required by interface

context_review.reason: Interface contract from BI-PF-1299 is the only real dependency; implementation is self-contained and highly testable.

private buckets, least-privilege credentials, lifecycle/versioning where required; explicit region/backup/replication capability metadata.
Signed URLs only after authorization, constrained to object/method, short TTL.

ADR document committed covering storage layers, backends, and data-flow decisions
Develop commit SHA pinned and recorded
11 Go interfaces defined in internal/storage/ with godoc and compile-time assertions
Conformance harness package exposes embeddable test suites per interface
In-memory reference adapter passes all conformance suites
